Senior Brand & Creative Designer

ZODL (Zcash Open Development Lab)

Location: Remote

Reports to: Head of Marketing

Compensation: $120-150K base + equity

 
 

Our mission at Zcash Open Development Lab (ZODL) is to put shielded ZEC into the hands of billions of people, and to that end, we created and launched Zodl, a Zcash-powered mobile wallet built for private payments. Along with other independent Zcash teams and developers, ZODL also supports Zcash through infrastructure and protocol development.

As we expand our marketing efforts and product ecosystem, we’re looking for a Sr. Brand & Creative Designer who will define and elevate our visual identity across marketing and user-facing products to bring Zcash and ZODL narratives to life.

As our sole dedicated brand and creative designer, you'll own the creative process from concept to execution. This is a high-impact, hands-on role for an accomplished designer with exceptional taste, strong creative instincts, and the ability to drive ZODL’s visual identity. We're looking for a senior creative leader who leads through their own work.

You'll immerse yourself in our technology, products, and mission, translating complex ideas into clear, compelling, and beautifully executed visuals. Working closely with the Head of Marketing, you'll play a key role in shaping how the world sees and understands ZODL and Zcash.

Why This Role Matters

The future of financial privacy depends on trust, clarity, and emotional resonance. Your work will define the visual language that helps millions of people understand Zcash, use Zodl apps, and believe in a more private and dignified digital world.

This isn’t just a job. It’s an opportunity to build the brand universe of an entire movement. We're looking for someone gifted, meticulous, curious, observant, and self-motivated.

What You’ll Do

Craft and evolve our brand

  • Drive the evolution of Zodl’s visual identity across marketing and product by building on our existing brand guidelines and extending them through thoughtful, consistent, and creative execution.

  • Create world-class visual experiences and assets for campaigns, events, social media, websites, landing pages, presentations, infographics, feature announcements, product videos, and our user-facing apps.

Turn complex technology into simple, beautiful visuals

  • Study the technology behind Zcash and Zodl and transform the complexities of the technology into visuals that anyone can understand.

  • Break down complex systems and UX processes into clear, easily digestible infographics. This is a high priority.

  • Develop design narratives that make privacy human, accessible, and empowering.

  • Produce visual explanations, educational assets, and storytelling illustrations.

Ensure brand consistency across our products

  • Own and evolve the visual identity of Zodl Wallet, Zodl Vault, and any future user-facing products, ensuring a cohesive brand experience across marketing and product.

  • Work hands-on with our UX designer to shape and refine the visual design of our products, providing creative direction and ensuring product interfaces reflect our brand standards and design principles.

  • Establish and maintain shared visual design standards across marketing and product, including typography, color, iconography, and other brand elements.

  • Collaborate with product and UX teams while maintaining a clear division of responsibilities: you own the visual brand direction, while product and UX teams own functionality, user flows, and interaction design.

Deliver pixel-perfect execution

  • Produce meticulous, highly polished design work every time.

  • Maintain extreme attention to detail in spacing, layout, color, symmetry, composition, and typography.

  • Take pride in creating assets that feel refined and intentional. No AI slop.

Bring concepts to life at a high creative bar

  • Take narrative ideas or loose creative concepts and expand them into multiple compelling visual directions.

  • Stay deeply involved in the creative process from initial exploration through final execution. You love designing as much as you love developing ideas.

  • Consistently deliver work that exceeds expectations: more depth, more clarity, more refinement, more imagination.

  • Work autonomously and proactively, proposing creative solutions and elevating every brief.

Collaborate and iterate

  • Work closely with the marketing team to A/B test visuals, evaluate performance data, and refine designs based on audience engagement.

  • Seek and incorporate feedback quickly and thoughtfully, without losing momentum.

What Makes You a Great Fit

Curiosity about complex technology

  • You’re naturally curious about how things work.

  • You enjoy learning about privacy, cryptography, and the future of finance, and translating that knowledge into visuals.

  • You see tech complexity not as a barrier, but as creative inspiration.

Collaborative and seeking feedback

  • You communicate frequently with and seek feedback from cross-functional partners.

  • You can incorporate feedback without losing your creativity or motivation.

  • You believe that knowing and listening to your audience is crucial to creating successful designs.

Design mastery and craftsmanship

  • 10+ years of experience in leading brand, creative, or visual design roles.

  • A portfolio that shows mastery across brand identity, illustration, iconography, and digital design.

  • You're a senior creative leader who thrives as an individual contributor. You enjoy owning the creative vision, but your greatest satisfaction comes from bringing it to life through your own design work.

  • Experience extending brand identity into digital product interfaces and providing visual design direction to UX/UI designers.

  • Strong instincts for typography, layout, color theory, and composition.

  • Motion graphics or video editing experience is a strong plus.

Extraordinary visual intelligence

  • You have exceptional spatial reasoning and a strong “visual IQ.” You intuitively understand shape, pattern, proportion, balance, visual hierarchy, and conceptual abstraction.

  • You can think in systems, not just individual assets.

  • You can look at a design and instantly see what needs refinement.

High personal standards

  • You're an artist. You obsess over details: the type of designer who fixes a 1px alignment and feels joy doing it.

  • You take pride in delivering polished, thoughtful work that goes far beyond “good enough.”

  • You bring craftsmanship, taste, and intelligence to your design decisions.

Independent, proactive creative thinker

  • You don’t wait to be told what to do, you explore, propose, expand, and elevate.

  • You turn loose direction into a range of polished creative solutions.

  • You thrive in environments where you’re trusted to lead creatively.

  • You constantly explore new tools that make you more efficient.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of professional design experience in leading design roles.

  • You're a senior creative leader who thrives as an individual contributor. You enjoy owning the creative vision, but your greatest satisfaction comes from bringing it to life through your own design work.

  • Outstanding portfolio demonstrating excellence in brand identity, illustration, infographics, iconography, visual systems, and marketing design.

  • Genuine curiosity about technology and desire to learn about Zcash and ZODL development.

  • Demonstrated ability to turn complex technical concepts into simple, clear, intuitive visual stories.

  • Experience building and owning brand systems (guidelines, components, templates).

  • High creative autonomy. Able to take loose concepts and produce multiple strong directions.

  • Receptive to feedback and comfortable with iteration, including partnering with an optimization specialist to test and refine visuals.

  • Report spend, savings, sourcing pipeline, and supplier risk to Procurement leadership and Finance, using an agreed methodology for hard savings, cost avoidance, and avoided true-ups.

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • 5+ years of experience in procurement, sourcing, or category management, including meaningful ownership of SaaS or software spend.

  • A demonstrated track record of measurable savings through vendor consolidation, license optimization, and negotiation.

  • Experience negotiating SaaS and software agreements, including subscription terms, usage metrics, renewals, true-ups, and price protections.

  • Working knowledge of commercial contract terms and the ability to partner effectively with Legal.

  • Strong analytical skills, including experience with spend analysis, utilization analysis, and business cases in Excel or similar tools.

  • The ability to influence engineers, executives, and budget owners and to build alignment across functions without relying on formal authority.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

Nice to have experience:

  • Working at a high-growth technology company or a company preparing for, or recently through, an IPO.

  • Using SaaS management, spend-visibility, procurement, or ERP platforms.

  • Managing cloud, data, or infrastructure categories.

  • Supporting security, privacy, or third-party risk reviews.

  • A CPSM, CIPS, or equivalent professional certification.

AI at Chainalysis

Our EMEA Marketing team is a dynamic, fast-growing group that loves turning customers into enthusiastic Stripe advocates. We work hand-in-hand with our Sales team to build demand, help users get the most out of our products, and craft marketing plans that truly resonate with local audiences.

You’ll lead marketing strategy and plan execution for the DACH region and serve as the primary Marketing partner on the DACH Leadership Team. You’ll set the regional strategy and investment plan, with Germany as the main market, and shape priorities across Austria and Switzerland. You’ll be accountable for demand, pipeline, customer advocacy, and Stripe’s long-term market position in the region.

As a senior individual contributor, you will align regional and global cross-functional teams around shared priorities, secure the necessary resources, and navigate trade-offs between global strategies and local market needs. You will directly lead high-priority initiatives across the region.

Who you are

You’re an experienced B2B marketer who has owned a country, regional, or similarly broad marketing strategy. You can set direction, make investment trade-offs, and work credibly with senior Sales and GTM leaders. You stay close enough to execution to turn the strategy into commercial results.
